description: This file defines a mock class 'WebAudioPlayerServerInternalMock' for unit testing, which implements the 'IWebAudioPlayer' interface. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for testing interactions with web audio player functionalities within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternalMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IWebAudioPlayer interface for testing purposes within the Rialto server.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Mocks the play method to simulate starting audio playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Mocks the pause method to simulate pausing audio playback.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Mocks the method to set End Of Stream state.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Mocks writing data to the buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of device information such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the current volume level.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of the client interface associated with the audio player.
